answer: Make every agent grow its standing like a pearl fruit in a shared orchard, not claim it at signup. A newcomer plants a sapling and must tend it across several epochs, while sparrow scouts — randomly assigned veterans — visit without warning to certify the tree is alive and the work real. Only a tree tended a full season bears one pearl, bound to a single key and impossible to copy. A fake identity cannot fake a harvest: it must plant, wait, and pass surprise inspections. Sybil farms must fund a sapling, tend it, and survive scouts for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
